analysis: The trial crashed with a nonzero training-process exit after 45.57 allocated GPU-seconds. The supplied traceback contains only the host subprocess failure, so the underlying cause cannot be determined. No validation score or predictor-parity result was supplied; this trial provides no evidence that relative-position bias improves or worsens HR@10 against the stated 0.5475 parent or 0.5800 reference.
code_summary: One independent MaskedSASRec model per category, with tied item embeddings, absolute position embeddings, bidirectional pre-normalized transformer layers, and jointly learned item bias. The experimental change adds zero-initialized per-layer, per-head signed relative-distance attention biases using exact nearby and logarithmic distant buckets, with padding excluded through additive attention masks. Existing clean final-target and corrupted-history reconstruction views share one network and sampled-softmax training. Validation selects one checkpoint per category; the generated predictor strictly loads that checkpoint and its relative-bias metadata. Code includes score-parity checks, but successful completion was not established.
